CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  January 16, 2024

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:00 P.M. in the Council Chambers of Alhambra City Hall,
  and via video conference and teleconference.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Bryden, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Mojarro, Pham, Tsujii, Garcia, Olson

  Absent:  Juarez

  Staff Present: Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director; Maia McCurley, Principal Planner;
  Megan Wu, Associate Planner; Jessica Vargas, Assistant Planner; Erica
  Vega, Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Olson

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – December 4, 2023 (7:01 P.M.)
  • Request: This is a request for the Planning Commission to approve
  the Minutes of the December 4, 2023, Regular Meeting of the
  Alhambra Planning Commission.
  • Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the December 4, 2023, Regular Meeting of
  the Alhambra Planning Commission.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Ho, Seconded by Commissioner Gardea
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 8-0-1-1
  Ayes:  Bryden, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Pham, Tsujii, Garcia, Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: Mojarro
  Absent: Juarez

  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio and video
  recordings of the discussion is available here:

E.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  •  There were no Discussion items.

F.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-22-30 (7:02 P.M.)
  • 1624 Front Street
  • Request: This is a continuation of the public hearing for an
  application for a Planned Development Permit PD-22-30 to construct
  a 427 square foot detached two-car garage; 1,526 square foot
  detached second unit; and legalize a 45 square foot addition to the rear
  of an existing single-family dwelling unit located in the R-3 (Multiple
  Family Residential) zone.
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution 23-29 approving Planned
  Development Permit PD-22-30 subject to the Conditions of Approval,
  and finding Planned Development Permit PD-22-30 to be exempt
  from review under the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  pursuant to Section 15303, Class 3 of Title 14 of the California Code
  of Regulations, which exempts from CEQA review projects that
  consist of new construction or conversion of small structures.
  • Assistant Planner Jessica Vargas provided the Staff presentation.
  • William Zhao, the Applicant, was available to answer questions.
  • The public hearing was opened and then closed.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Ho, Seconded by Commissioner Pham.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Bryden, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Mojarro, Pham, Tsujii,
  Garcia, Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: Juarez

  AGENDA
  ITEM 3:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-23-62 AND VARIANCE
  VAR-23-18 (7:10 P.M.)
  • 823 South Sierra Vista Avenue
  • Request: This is a continuation of the public hearing for an
  application for a Planned Development Permit PD-23-62 and
  2
  01/16/2024
   Variance VAR-23-18 to construct a 1,775 square foot detached
  second unit with an attached garage, and convert an existing one-car
  garage into a two-car garage with insufficient interior depth and
  vehicle back-up space distance located in the R-3 (Multiple Family
  Residential) zone.
  •  Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution 23-36 approving Planned
  Development Permit PD-23-62 and Variance VAR-23-18 subject to
  the Conditions of Approval, and finding Planned Development Permit
  PD-23-62 and Variance VAR-23-18 to be exempt from review under
  the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to
  Section 15303, Class 3 of Title 14 of the California Code of
  Regulations, which exempts from CEQA review projects that
  consistent of new construction or conversion of small structures.
  •  Principal Planner Maia McCurley provided the Staff presentation.
  •  Dat Wong, the Applicant, was available to answer questions.
  •  The public hearing was opened and then closed.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve with one (1) added condition of approval to: 1.) Install
  a minimum 19’ wide garage door in the proposed new 2-car garage
  attached to the existing single-family residence at the front of the
  property.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Gardea, Seconded by Vice President Garcia.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Bryden, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Mojarro, Pham, Tsujii,
  Garcia, Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain None
  Absent: Juarez

AGENDA
ITEM 4:  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT CUP-23-29 (7:24 P.M.)
  • 424 West Valley Boulevard
  • Request: This is a continuation of the public hearing for an
  application for a Conditional Use Permit CUP-23-29 to permit motor
  vehicle sales at an existing commercial building located in the VSP
  (Valley Boulevard Corridor Specific Plan) zone.
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution 23-37 approving
  Conditional Use Permit CUP-23-29 subject to the Conditions of
  Approval, and finding Conditional Use Permit CUP-23-29 to be
  exempt from review under the California Environmental Quality Act
  (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15301, Class 1 of Title 14 of the
  California Code of Regulations, which exempts from CEQA review
  projects that are existing facilities.
  • Principal Planner Maia McCurley provided the Staff presentation.
  3
  01/16/2024
   •  David Wang, the Applicant and Business Owner, provided the
  Applicant presentation and was available to answer questions.
  •  The public hearing was opened and then closed.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Ho, Seconded by Commissioner Pham.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Bryden, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Mojarro, Pham, Tsujii,
  Garcia, Olson
  Noes:  None
  Recuse: None
  Absent: Juarez

AGENDA
ITEM 5:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-22-37 AND VARIANCE
  VAR-22-09 (7:38 P.M.)
  • 69 East Main Street
  • Request: This is a request to revise the previously approved Planned
  Development Permit PD-22-37 and Variance VAR-22-09 allowing
  the establishment of a discount variety store, Dollar Tree, in an
  existing commercial lease space with less than the required number
  of parking spaces located at 69 East Main Street in the CBD (Central
  Business District) zone and Downtown Revitalization District
  Overlay.
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution 24-01 approving a
  revision to Planned Development Permit PD-22-37 and Variance
  VAR-22-09 subject to the Conditions of Approval, and finding the
  revision to Planned Development Permit PD-22-37 and Variance
  VAR-22-09 to be exempt from review under the California
  Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15301, Class
  1 of Title 14 of the California Code of Regulations, which exempts
  from CEQA review projects that are existing facilities.
  • Principal Planner Maia McCurley provided the Staff presentation.
  • Steven Schechter (HCP Alhambra, LLC) and Chuy Duc Le (DLR
  Group), the Applicant/Property Owner and the architect,
  respectively, provided the Applicant presentation and were available
  to answer questions.
  • The public hearing was opened and then closed.
  • Public Comments:
  • 1.) Lewis McCammon

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve with four (4) added/revised conditions of approval to:
  1.) Eliminate the requirement to install a window with visual
  4
  01/16/2024
   permeability; 2.) Incorporate a significant mural or artwork that spans
  along Main Street with the option to wrap around Stoneman Avenue; 3.)
  Modify PL14 to specify that if landscaping is installed it shall be
  maintained; and 4.) The Applicant shall obtain input from the City’s Arts
  & Cultural Events Commission and the Alhambra Historical Society prior
  to finalizing the design of the mural or artwork.
  •  Moved by Vice President Garcia, Seconded by Commissioner Gardea.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Bryden, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Mojarro, Pham, Tsujii,
  Garcia, Olson
  Noes:  None
  Recuse: None
  Absent: Juarez
